name: r3-collect-sword
description: HAND-AUTHORED, and the first tape on the ladder that COLLECTS AN ITEM FOR REAL. Boots into level 10 south of sword@48,48, walks north onto it, and then presses X five times to talk the pickup's dialogue through. grants is EMPTY: hasSword becomes true because the game's own Sword.removed() ran, not because a property was written. What it pins is the CEREMONY's shape, which no earlier fixture could see: contact freezes the game for the 150-frame specialTimer during which the tick counter does NOT advance (Pickup is the only writer of the freeze flag, so the dead-frame gate holds), and then the tick counter DOES advance while the player still cannot move — Game.freezeObjects has several writers and no per-frame reset, so it reads true inside Mobile.mobileUpdate and false again at the next frame's gate. That is why the tape can supply the X releases at all: NPC.talk() reads Input.released from the NPC's own update, outside the frozen block. The releases are spaced EIGHT ticks apart on purpose — the sword's own dialogue says 'double tap to dash', slashTimer is 20, and a press that lands after the ceremony is over goes to useItem(Main.primary): one stray press is a swing, two within twenty ticks is a DASH that moves the player. Driver-synthesized is not an option here, because every planner on this ladder treats a pickup as an avoid volume and refuses to walk into one.
